title: Decide whether a cloud clone arms the main-ref reference-transaction hook
why: Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 23:56 CST Nov 8: in cloud clones, `githooks/main-ref/install.sh --check` reports the reference-transaction hook is not armed. Open: can a cloud clone arm it, and should it?
note: First read what the hook guards and how the cloud SessionStart install runs; compare step banchi-make-hooks-arms.
